WHAT: iOS 26 reorganized Settings — keyboard setup path changed from previous versions
PATH:
1. Open Settings
2. Tap General
3. Scroll down to find 'Keyboard' section
4. Tap row showing 'Keyboards, N' (N = current count)
5. Tap 'Add New Keyboard...'
6. Scroll to find 'Whisnap' under third-party keyboards
7. Tap it to install
8. Tap back to 'Keyboards' list
9. Tap 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' row to open settings
10. Toggle 'Allow Full Access' (no system alert in iOS 26 — silent toggle)
GOTCHA: Installed keyboard shows as 'WhisnapKeyboard — Whisnap' (not just 'Whisnap'). Full access toggle has NO confirmation dialog in iOS 26 (removed). 'Keyboards' text appears multiple times (nav bar title + row) — use index or exact text match.
